schedule: Point screens first: one warmup and three alternating scored runs per arm. Only if all point cells qualify, run batch guards with the same schedule.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput per exact binary and workload; p99, syncs, frontiers, coalesce waits and grouping counts come from that same invocation. Report unfiltered samples too.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run using mean times; passing means can still hide brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Candidate moves framing and frame CRC for all v7 DATA sizes to the producer.
Baseline is the same retained dynamic grouping binary.
Source and scratch databases remain inside the local repository.
